title: PhAST 0.18.0: Phase-field Autograd Solver in Torch
description:
PhAST is a PyTorch finite-element solver for phase-field fracture. Version 0.18.0 extends the two-dimensional dynamic and quasi-static solver with a beta three-dimensional periodic-voxel solver and three worked 3D examples.

The release contains solver sources, installation requirements, documentation, tests, YAML and Python examples, selected stored results, and glass and alumina scalar-inversion recipes associated with the CMAME article. It does not contain every dataset or figure-generation input from that article. The reproduction guide describes the coverage and limitations.

Code is licensed under MIT. The two archived scalar recovery histories retain CC BY 4.0; see reproduction/cmame_2026/README.md.
